slides: Your body is a ledger, not a bucket.
Every calorie you eat writes a line of credit or debt.
Macronutrients are the currency that funds cellular work.
If the ledger stays positive, energy flows without crash.
Track what you consume, and let your balance stay in the black.
Alignment is the quiet contract between intention and action.
When your daily tasks mirror your core values, friction disappears.
Brain chemistry rewards consistency, reinforcing the pattern.
Misaligned actions create cognitive dissonance, draining willpower.
Audit your to‑do list weekly—keep only what matches your why.
Momentum in training is built in the rest between sets.
Short pauses keep heart rate elevated, preserving metabolic fire.
Active recovery (light mobility) clears lactate without killing intensity.
The nervous system stays primed, so the next set feels easier to start.
Use 30‑second active breaks to turn rest into a performance booster.
Habits are the autopilot you program while awake.
Repeated cues trigger the same neural loop, bypassing decision fatigue.
Stacking a tiny new action onto an existing habit cements it faster.
Consistency beats perfection; a 2‑minute habit beats a 2‑hour plan.
Pick one anchor habit today and attach a micro‑action to it.
